items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, wait a minute. Do you know when I first remember Miss --

ctx.x: Now, you know, it's kind of funny because I was kind of asking Maxine leading questions yesterday, I was asking her whether she liked to record with big bands, with strings --
Now, wait a minute. Do you know when I first remember Miss --
Can I just ask this -- how did it grab you to sing with an organ trio?
